title: Enhancing Semantic Segmentation with Continual Self-Supervised Pre-training (GLARE)
mechanism: Continual SSL for segmentation with patch-level local consistency and a regional consistency constraint, updating only lightweight adapters on a frozen SSL ViT.
adaptation: Alternative to ExPLoRA with a dense objective; regions from the structural classes (busbar, ribbon, padding, cell) predicted by the house model on pool cells.
min_experiment: Same protocol as ExPLoRA arm; kill if < +0.02 E1 relF1@2 over off-the-shelf DINOv3 in Dino U-Net.
evidence: R: consistent gains across several segmentation benchmarks in different domains with small overhead (abstract, no numbers retrieved).
prior_overlap: MIM/DDeP on ResNet-34 n.d.; dense continual SSL on a ViT foundation model is open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Regions from our structural classes (busbar / finger / cell); a cheap second choice after NeCo for a ViT arm.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: DINOv3 ViT-B VFM arm after GLARE on pool. Baseline: same arm without. Kill if E1 crack recall < +0.01.
